facts.fact: 夜里大风掀倒好几棵树，狗坟、石堆墓与粉杜鹃全被树根与泥土盖住
facts.anchor: A couple of trees fell during the night.

facts.fact: 他突然发现自己想哭——圣地的失去比他预想的更震动，那是他的快乐之地，也是 Caroline 特别的地方
facts.anchor: He found himself suddenly close to tears. The loss of the shrine, the clearing, had shaken him more than he’d expected.

facts.fact: 树根里翻出一块老骨头，他想起 Lucy 说过的话：这片荒原全是死人
facts.anchor: Then he remembered what Lucy had said: The whole of this moor is dead people.

facts.fact: 已断线的座机自己响了——不是手机，是那部他明知断线的拨盘座机
facts.anchor: The telephone rang. Not his mobile, but the old dial-up telephone he knew was disconnected.

facts.fact: Dr Benn 警告：你必须离开这栋房子，我们在这里，但我们不是独自一个
facts.anchor: You have to get out of the house. Right now. We’re here, but we’re not alone.

facts.fact: Benn 在电话里说 Caroline 死了，死在 Firefleet 的雪里
facts.anchor: She died. She died in the snow, at Firefleet.

facts.fact: 电话断线后变成机器人的声音反复吟诵「I'm here. I'm hererrrrrr—」
facts.anchor: with a dull, robotic voice intoning over and over again

facts.fact: 他梦见有人大声敲 door，听见狐狸的尖叫，黎明时醒来，看见六英寸厚的雪与远处的雷声
facts.anchor: he dreamed of someone at the door, knocking, loudly and persistently, and heard the screaming of foxes, and awoke at dawn to six inches of snow and a distant sound of thunder.
